description:
My Property Box are delighted to present this well-appointed one-bedroom apartment with stunning views over the Quayside, located within the sought-after Baltic Quay development.

Situated on the first floor, the property is tastefully decorated and furnished throughout, offering modern and comfortable living. The open-plan kitchen and living area features a breakfast bar, electric hob and oven, a large fridge/freezer, and a washer/dryer, creating a practical and stylish space. The apartment benefits from wood-effect flooring throughout the living areas, with a carpeted bedroom for added comfort. The bathroom includes a shower over the bath, and the property also comes with the added benefit of a secure allocated parking space.

Ideally located just a short walk from the vibrant Quayside, residents can enjoy an excellent selection of bars, restaurants, and cafes, along with easy access to Newcastle City Centre.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this fantastic apartment has to offer. To arrange a viewing, please contact My Property Box on 0191 212 0400 today.
